scope: 2025 federal and 2023 provincial election results for the four electoral districts containing the 200 preview property points. This is one prior general-election result per representative, not a multiyear trend.
geographyWarning: Results describe the entire electoral district, not the named community or quadrant. Communities may overlap districts. Join by resolved property district/representativeId, not by a community-wide assumed representative.
historyWarning: Do not compare these 2025 federal vote shares directly with a same-named 2021 riding: the 2023 Representation Orders changed boundaries. Earlier boundaries or an official transposition are needed. Party labels are election-time affiliations.
calculationNotes: Candidate votes, displayed one-decimal shares and turnout come directly from official results. Margin votes and margin percentage points are independently calculated; rounded official shares may not total 100. Minor provincial parties retain the official abbreviation where a full name was not separately verified.
